evidence.title: SUN ranks first in blind AI audio benchmark
evidence.text: Our Science Team ran a blind benchmark comparing four AI audio generation pipelines: NotebookLM, Spotify's Save-to-Spotify workflow, and two SUN pipelines. SUN ranked number one overall. The benchmark compared quality, engagement, learning, production, and safety under the same source material and evaluation protocol.
evidence.matchReason: Native post from exact canonical SUN founder Artin Bogdanov's mapped LinkedIn account. The post explicitly reports SUN product benchmark results and methodology.
